title: 'I have every reason to believe' - Arne Slot confident Liverpool job is safe despite 'not great season'
desc: Arne Slot has insisted he expects to remain in the Liverpool dugout next season despite a disappointing campaign that has seen the Reds struggle to defend their Premier League crown. The Dutchman has faced mounting pressure from sections of the Anfield faithful as his side battles to secure a place in the Champions League.
